race.comment: STAY HUMBLE (3) was disappointing setting up a good tempo at Sandown Hillside last time but was in the market there and the form has stood up quite well. Two runs prior were rock solid in decent company and he should take catching with Jabez Johnstone sticking. PENTLE BAY (4) got home well off a slow speed behind Perfect Ten last time with that horse winning on Saturday since. Tricky draw but he's going well and is right in this. BLUE BANDIT (5) can mix form a bit but was good last time at Sandown Lakeside and should run well on the quick turnaround. ALL BUSINESS (10) struggled second up but had been solid fresh here and is good enough on her day. TEL AVIV (14) maps for every chance and is in the mix.
